title: Retire ralph/swarm enum from run_event schema
description: schemas/websocket/messages.schema.json still names the deleted tk run modes (ralph, swarm-orchestrator, swarm-subagent) as run_event source values, and the enum is codegen'd into both internal/types/generated and internal/tickboard/ui/src/types/generated. Replace with substrate-shaped sources per the design doc: cloud:orchestrator, cloud:worker, harness, herdr, pi. Run pnpm codegen so Go and TS regenerate together; update project-room.ts and any fixtures referencing the old values. No producer emits run_event today, so this is a rename with no live traffic — do it before Phase 2 creates the first real producer.
acceptance_criteria: The old mode names appear nowhere in schemas, generated code, worker source, or fixtures. pnpm codegen:check passes. Existing cloud worker tests pass unchanged.
